PAY THE PRO THE SECOND IT'S DONE.

Say what's wrong in a sentence, here on the site, or let your AI agent do it for you. Done writes down what “done” means, pros quote, and PayPal holds the money. The pro sends photos and a receipt, every condition is checked, and when they all pass PayPal pays the pro.

Post a job yourself
→
Or let your AI agent do it

Judging? Take the 3-minute tour: it runs one job from scope to payout on this server.

WORK ORDER
ONE JOB, START TO FINISH

Homeowners are afraid of paying first and being left with a dripping faucet. Pros are afraid of finishing and waiting weeks to be paid. A written definition of done, with the money held by PayPal, settles both.

1
Scope

You say it in a sentence. Done writes the work order: what to do, and the done-conditions, each naming the photo, receipt or note that proves it.

the contract

2
Offers

Nearby pros' agents quote from their own price rules. Your agent counters once, inside the ceiling you set, and accepts.

agent to agent (A2A)

3
Hold

PayPal authorizes the price plus a buffer for change orders. Nothing is charged. Past 3 days it's reauthorized; it can't outlive 29.

Orders v2 · AUTHORIZE

4
Evidence

The pro photographs the work and the receipt. The phone's camera stamps the time and place; a change order ("the valve is corroded too, +$45") comes with a photo.

EXIF · dHash · OCR

5
Checks

Each condition gets pass, fix or fail with a reason and a confidence, labelled model or rules. Code decides: all pass, it pays; a doubt goes to you.

decided by code

6
Payout

PayPal captures exactly what's due. One Payouts batch pays the pro and their helper, each their share. The unused hold is never charged.

capture · Payouts batch

WHY IT RUNS ON PAYPAL

Every dollar moves through PayPal, and every id is on the screen: the order, the authorization, the capture, the payout batch and each item, any refund.

Hold now, charge when done

Orders v2 with intent AUTHORIZE, then capture, void or reauthorize. No escrow account of our own.

Your agent pays without seeing a card

The first hold is approved once with PayPal's buttons and saved in the vault; after that your agent can accept offers inside your limits.

The pro is paid in seconds, with an email

One Payouts batch pays the pro and their helper, each to their own verified PayPal. No bank details, no 1–3 day ACH wait.

A fair way out

A dispute settles as part release and part refund with PayPal Refunds, so the customer sees it in PayPal. Platform fee: a flat 10%, shown on every job.

BUILT FOR YOUR AGENT

Your agent connects over MCP (or A2A) with a token you make. You set the limits in dollars: per job, per month, and how big a change order it may approve alone. It can never choose who gets paid.
